media.loading.description: Accessible name of the progress while a picture of a post loads in the image viewer, and the words read while an audio attachment loads after Play.

media.failed.defaultMessage: Diese Medien konnten nicht geladen werden.
media.failed.description: Shown over a picture or an audio attachment of a post that could not load.

media.reload.description: Button over a picture or an audio attachment of a post that could not load: it loads it again.
